== Summary ==
The "Rosemount Bespin Cube 2016" glass trophy for the Power Cube 2016 event, posted by organizer [[Mark Walseth]] on 1 June 2016 ("Prize #1").

* '''Event:''' [[2016 Bespin Power Cube]]

Forum attachment id 4786.jpg (Bespin Cube 2016.jpg). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261122222841/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1037588.html Internet Archive]
